_approach: Clap-stack build: bar 1 is quarter-note claps under the drop-the-two kick, bar 2 steps up to 8ths then 16ths with velocity ramping to 127 on the last four steps, while the kick thins to just the downbeat so the clap wall is unmistakably the lead voice into the drop. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
